description: Troy Balderson grew up in Zanesville fixing cars, working on his family’s farm, racing bikes, and getting dirty. If it was broken, Troy could fix it.“My father put a wrench in my hand as soon as I could hold it. We need to get shop class back in our schools and teach kids the satisfaction that comes with building and fixing things again.”
